csv_project_name: DEV Service for St. ElizabetHS East Redevelopment Parcel 1
csv_agency: Office of the Deputy Mayor for Planning & Econ Dev
csv_scope_of_work: The Government of the District of Columbia (the District ), through the Office of the Deputy Mayor for Planning and Economic Development ( DMPED ), is releasing this Request for Proposals ( RFP ) as it seeks to receive proposals (each, a Proposal and collectively, Proposals ) from individuals and/or teams (each, a Respondent and collectively, Respondents ) for the redevelopment of certain property located at 2724 Martin Luther King Jr. Avenue, SE, SE (the Development Parcel or Parcel 1 ) (see Figure 1: Development Parcel Map) on the East Campus of St. Elizabeths Hospital ( St. Elizabeths East ). . Location 2724 Martin Luther King Jr. Avenue, SE. ttainment of District Goals i. Respond to the development goals and planning principles of the Master Plan; ii. Improve connectivity to the East campus Sector with the Congress Heights neighborhood by building new highquality, resilient, public infrastructure; iii. Provide new landscaping that is unobtrusive and does not detract from the new development; iv. Improve the quality of life for the surrounding neighborhood; v. Address District and stakeholder concerns and requirements; vi. Respond to the goals and objectives of the Comp Plan; vii. Address community preferences; viii. Maximize affordable housing, particularly family-sized units and homeownership opportunities; ix. Create job opportunities and/or apprenticeship programs for District of Columbia residents particularly for District of Columbia residents within 1-mile of the Development Parcel and exceed the requirements of the CBE Act (which requirements are detailed in the First Source and Certified Business Enterprises sub-sections of the Common Requirements section); and x. Meet any other additional goals identified throughout this RFP and any other District policy documents.
